name: VAU (Verified Adam-metric Update) for AdamW-trained LoRA erasure
source: CANDIDATES.md (selection C-H1, narrowed) + agents/C_candidate_spec.md + F_REVIEW.md section 4.2 fixes; protocol configs/eval_protocol.json v1.1 + A2
novelty: NONE (composition of known parts: metric/scaled gradient projection of the actual Adam step, backtracking with a fresh-batch Hoeffding gate)

optimizer.lr: tuned: lr0 * 10^{-1,-0.5,0,0.5}, lr0 calibrated per family on dev seeds 0..7 (FREEZE.json)

probe.type: Gaussian sketch Sigma J_R1(theta), Sigma = Z[:k]/sqrt(k), Z (k_max x N_r d) iid N(0,1) from stream 3
probe.refresh_counter: step() calls (data index), never rolled back
probe.family_overrides: G1 exact-J cells use all R1 rows with K = 1; G7 cells set (K, k)

metric: D = 1/(sqrt(vhat) + eps) of the tentative AdamW state (bias-corrected with the committed step counter + 1)
projection: Delta1 = Delta0 - D * (S^T (S diag(D) S^T + mu I)^{-1} S Delta0)
no_probe_rule: if S is empty or all-zero the correction AND the reject rule are skipped (VAU == AdamW bitwise)
reject_rule: if g . Delta1 >= 0: null step (no gate tries, no batch consumed, nothing committed, theta unchanged)

gate.statistic: rho_hat = mean_{x in R2} min(||f_x(theta + s Delta1) - f_x(theta0)||^2 / Z, M)
gate.accept: rho_hat + M sqrt(ln(T R/delta)/(2 n2)) <= tau^2
gate.tau2: tuned: tau0^2 * {0.5, 1.5}, tau0^2 calibrated per family (FREEZE.json); G8 centre tau0^2
gate.T: planned steps of the run (60 models a/b, 23 in G9, 28 model c)
gate.fresh_batches: R2 batches are a stream-4 pool consumed sequentially by tries, never reused

commit: on acceptance theta += s Delta1 and (m', v', t+1) from the RAW gradient are committed; otherwise (theta, m, v, t) unchanged
adam_step_counter: incremented only on commit; bias correction uses it
units: Z = mean ||b - a||^2 over target_test at theta0 (models a, b); model c gate on velocities normalised by Z_v (target-sel velocity contrast)
